prompt: A wizard school: brew the potion from three ingredients in the cauldron

intent.setting: A grand library and laboratory inside an ancient wizarding school
intent.goal: Collect three specific ingredients from shelves and drop them into the cauldron to brew a working potion.
intent.fail: The liquid turns red and bursts into smoke, restarting the quest.
intent.headline: Cauldron brewing triggers win only on exact 3-ingredient match
